name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: Elling sends you to find Private Hendel, and a local officer fears the reason may be troubling. Hendel was stationed at Sentry Point, the first tower outside Theramore, where you are asked to seek signs of him.

sections.title: At the Tower
sections.body: A local officer knows Private Hendel and says he was stationed at Sentry Point, the first tower outside Theramore. The officer fears Elling sent you there first because your business may be troubling. Tell the officer what you can share. The watch must protect these lands, so any disturbance matters.

faq.answer: Private Hendel is the man Elling sent you to find. A local officer says Hendel was stationed at the first tower outside Theramore.

faq.q: Where should I look for Hendel?
faq.answer: Look for signs of Private Hendel at Sentry Point, the first tower outside Theramore.

faq.q: Who sent me to find Hendel?
faq.answer: Elling sent you to find Private Hendel.
The officer fears Elling sent you there first because your business may be troubling. The officer wants to know what you can share to protect the lands.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Missing Diplomat
